card.headline: Which Cypriot became European all-around champion in 2024?
*Marios Georgiou*, in Rimini.
card.explain: The first Cypriot to win the European all-around title, with 84.265 points.

alt: Quiz Story: Which Cypriot became European all-around champion in gymnastics in 2024? Options: Marios Georgiou, Pavlos Kontides, Milan Trajkovic, Kalia Antoniou.
Answer Story: Marios Georgiou, in Rimini in 2024, the first Cypriot to win the European all-around title, with 84.265 points.

facts.claim: Marios Georgiou (Cyprus) won the men's all-around title at the 2024 European Championships in Rimini with 84.265 points
Georgiou was the first Cypriot to win the European all-around title
